tg_house_e_teacher: I teach four hundred children that the Great Deluge was weather.
It is in the primer. Weather, a long time ago, and then we rebuilt.
A woman from the Institute told me last month that the primer is wrong.
She would not say what the right answer was. She said she did not have one yet.
tg_house_e_kid: We had to draw the sea for school. I drew it with something under it.
Miss said that was imagination. Then she kept the drawing.
